author: Temminck & Schlegel, 1847
summary: 전국의 산림과 공원에 사는 흔한 텃새이다. 나무 구멍이나 건물 틈에서 번식하며 4~7월에 알을 5~8개 낳는다. 번식기에는 암수가 함께 지내고, 그 뒤에는 작은 무리를 이루거나 다른 종과 섞인 무리로 지낸다. 곤충을 주로 먹고 여러 씨앗과 열매도 먹으며, 국외에서는 일본에 분포한다.

art.subject: Varied Tit (Sittiparus varius), adult (plumage the same all year): forehead and face creamy buff-white; crown and nape black with a narrow creamy stripe down the centre of the nape; black chin and throat forming a bib; a creamy-white band on the upper breast below the bib; rest of the underparts rich chestnut; back, wings and tail plain blue-grey; short stout black bill; dark eye; dark grey legs.
art.pose: perched on a branch near a tree cavity, side view
art.scene: Korean mixed woodland with mature trees; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched on a branch: black crown, creamy buff forehead and cheek, black bib, plain blue-grey back, wings and tail, rich chestnut flanks and belly
adult, front view perched: creamy face framing the black throat bib, creamy-white upper breast band, chestnut lower breast and belly
art.build: Small tit, 14cm: about the length of a House Sparrow and the same size as a Cinereous Tit. Large rounded head without a crest, short neck. Bill short, stout and pointed, black, a little stronger than in other tits. Legs short, dark grey. At rest the wingtips reach the base of the tail. Tail medium length, square-ended, plain blue-grey. Tame and inquisitive; hammers seeds held under its feet.
avoid: Do not paint white cheeks with a black belly stripe; that is Cinereous Tit.
Do not paint a chestnut or orange head; the face is creamy buff and the crown black.
Do not paint a crest or wing bars; the wings are plain blue-grey.
Do not paint a long nuthatch-like bill.
